name: Devouring Serpents
disable: DC 38 Occultism check (expert) or Religion (expert) to placate Yig, or DC 41 Athletics check (master) to force the serpents' jaws closed; three successes total to disable the haunt
routine: The haunt makes a jaws Strike against each creature in the chamber as its first action. As its second action, it forces each creature hit by its jaws Strike to attempt a DC 34 Reflex save save. On a failure, the creature is Grabbed until it Escapes. On a critical failure, or if the creature was already grabbed by the haunt, it becomes Restrained instead.

items.name: Spectral Snakebites
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches Jazali's religious symbol.

---
Effect Puncture wounds appear across the flesh of the triggering creature, who must attempt a DC 39 Fortitude save save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 3d12+17 piercing damage.

Failure As failure, except the creature also takes 2d6 persistent,bleed damage as their blood fails to clot.

Critical Failure As failure, except the persistent bleed damage is 4d6.

text: Spectral serpents emerge from the ground to devour living creatures.
